(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const n=s.sheep.find(x=>!x.isWolf); s.pointer({type:'down',x:n.x-120,y:n.y,id:1}); s.pointer({type:'move',x:n.x-60,y:n.y,id:1}); s.pointer({type:'move',x:n.x,y:n.y,id:1}); s.pointer({type:'up',x:n.x,y:n.y,id:1}); return {test:'dragging the torch over a sheep does not pick it', phase:s.phase, ok: s.phase==='hunt'}})()

(()=>{const farm=[]; const br=['white','brown','grey','black','rose','ram','lamb','lopear']; for(let i=0;i<24;i++) farm.push({uid:i+1,breed:br[i%8],name:'S'+i,x:Math.random(),y:Math.random()}); const d=ctw.save.data; d.farm=farm; ctw.save.write(); Date._real=Date.now; Date.now=()=>180000; ctw.go('farm'); return 'farm at night'})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; let inside=0; for(const sh of s.sheep) for(const o of s.world.avoid) if(Math.hypot(sh.x-o.x,sh.y-o.y) < o.r) inside++; const sleeping=s.sheep.filter(x=>x.state==='lie'||x.state==='sleep').length; return {test:'farm night: sheep nap, none stuck inside props', label: document.querySelector('[data-time]').textContent, sleeping, inside, ok: inside===0 && sleeping>=4}})()
